Native public-command qualification is reported separately in docs/harness/codex-runtime.md; component probes do not establish product acceptance.
verification_scope.native_tui: Codex 0.162.1 macOS arm64: exact CODEX_THREAD_ID across launch/resume, canonical writable specialist delegation, manual Goal entry, native continuation beyond 900 seconds, user pause and accounting preservation observed in disposable fixtures. Short whole-command Goal paste qualified; large pastes require the canonical objective to remain file-referenced. Requested runtime fields are not backend attestation.
verification_scope.isolated_review: Canonical explicitly read-only App Server threads retained inherited approval settings, denied an actual write with EPERM, preserved the live reviewer across reconnects, and used a distinct execution reviewer. Historical dynamic-tool callbacks have been removed from the coordinator path.
